Who was Peter Drucker and what is MBO?

Peter Drucker presented Management by Objectives (MBO) in his 1954 book "The Practice of Management." MBO focuses on setting objectives collaboratively between managers and subordinates. The goals are clearly defined so that every member within the or ganization understands their expectations and how they should work towards achieving organizational goals. This concept aims to create value for both employees and organizations by aligning individual efforts with collective success.

explain more (follow-up)

Scientific Management, as described in the previous answer, focuses on understanding precisely what needs to be done by employees and then implementing methods to ensure these tasks are carried out efficiently and cost-effectively. This approach emphasizes precise planning and execution, aligning closely with the principles of management that involve optimizing resource usage across various disciplines for maximum output or results.
